note: Common Step 2 CK cardiology presentations. 'guideline_file' is the PDF you save in guidelines/cardio/. 'verified' marks whether the guideline version was checked as current in Nov 2026; check the false ones yourself before relying on them. 'ecg_codes' are PTB-XL SCP-ECG codes; an ECG with one of them is attached to the case (empty list = no ECG). Edit freely. Optional 'ecg_rate' [min, max] in beats/min (null = no limit) makes the script pick only tracings in that range, e.g. AF with RVR needs a fast one.
